turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've got one week off and I want a proper road trip, but I'm stuck on where.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me describe all the options before you comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Up north there's a lake district loop with tiny villages, narrow roads and loads of walking.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Down south I could follow the coast, stopping in a different seaside town every night.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or I head inland to the wine region, flat easy driving and lots of tastings, though I'd need a designated driver.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My mate also suggested a ferry across and just driving wherever on the continent.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's all of them. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: For a week alone, the seaside towns sound ideal, a new place every night with simple roads. The lakes are lovely but the narrow lanes get tiring, the wine trip needs a driver, and the ferry is great if you love improvising.
